title: Isobars, Isotones & Isodiaphers
topicTitle: Rutherford's atomic model and its limitations
notes: **Isobars:** several atoms having the same mass number but different atomic numbers are called isobars. The word 'isobar' derives from two Greek words, isos = equal and baros = heavy.

**Isobar properties:** isobars are atoms of different elements having different atomic numbers but the same mass number; they possess entirely different physical and chemical properties. The total number of nucleons (protons + neutrons) remains the same, while the number of protons and electrons differs.

**Isotones:** different atoms having different atomic numbers and mass numbers but the same number of neutrons are called isotones. The word 'isotone' derives from Greek, isos = the same and tonos = neutrons.
**Isotone properties:** isotones have different physical and chemical properties since they are entirely different elements; the number of electrons and protons differ in isotones.
